title: Medical Records Requests Delivery Standard
content:
## Standard

1. Records released under Medical Records Requests go by one of the request type's delivery methods.
2. Unencrypted email is used only where the request type allows unencrypted email and the patient acknowledges the risk.
3. Releases longer than the request type's fax page limit are not faxed.
4. Records waiting for pickup are held for the request type's pickup hold period, in calendar days.
5. The delivery method of an open request may be changed. The request status is received, authorization pending, in process or extended when the delivery method is changed.
6. Diagnostic images are included only where the request type includes them; the format produced is the request type's record format.
7. Where the request type includes a custodian affidavit, a signed custodian affidavit accompanies the records; where the request type requires a release log entry, the release is entered in the disclosure log.

Whether a request is open for a change of delivery method is read from the status on the request's own record at the time of the change.

## Changing the delivery method

| Status of the request on its record | Delivery method may be changed |
|---|---|
| Received | Yes |
| Authorization pending | Yes |
| In process | Yes |
| Extended | Yes |
| Fulfilled | No |
| Denied | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## Unencrypted email, both conditions

| Type allows unencrypted email | Patient acknowledges the risk | Unencrypted email used |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | May be used |
| Yes | No | Not used |
| No | Yes | Not used |
| No | No | Not used |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A request whose type's fax page limit is 40 pages: a release of 40 pages is not longer than the limit and is not barred from fax; a release of 41 pages is longer and is not faxed.
- A request in process, on a type offering both mail and pickup, whose delivery method is to change from mail to pickup: the request is open, so the method may be changed. The same change asked for after the records were delivered may not be made, since the request is fulfilled.
